The question asks who performed the lead single on the album "Friends in Low Places, No Fences" that reached #1 on Billboard. From the source [Friends in Low Places], the song "Friends in Low Places" was performed by Garth Brooks and was the lead single from his album "No Fences". The source [No Fences] confirms this album is by Garth Brooks. Therefore, the performer is Garth Brooks.

Final answer: Garth Brooks
